profile.headline: .NET Developer | Angular | Azure
profile.geoLocationName: West Palm Beach, Florida, United States
profile.summary:
Full-stack Software Engineer skilled in .NET, Angular, EF Core, SQL Server, and Azure. Experienced in modernizing legacy systems, building scalable multi-tenant applications, and designing high-performance REST APIs.

Proven track record in improving performance (up to 98%), enhancing UI/UX, and leading offshore teams to deliver low-defect, high-quality code. Recent projects include a .NET 9/Angular 18 Utilization Report app aggregating data across multiple tenant databases and FHIR-compatible API integrations.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Boca Raton, Florida, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
• Transformed unstable wound care platform into a stable, revenue-generating app used by multiple healthcare organizations and tenants.
• Built and deployed Utilization Report application in .NET 9, Angular 18, EF Core, and Azure Functions. Aggregated data from multi-tenant databases and automated weekly email reports via Azure.
• Delivered new clinician reporting tools (Healing Progress, Treatment/Wound Progress) to enhance decision-making.
• Improved application performance by 98% by optimizing LINQ queries to reduce unnecessary in-memory enumeration and implementing caching.
• Led UI/UX redesigns of dashboards and grids, improving workflow and aligning with branding.
• Streamlined multi-tenant onboarding for hospitals with batch CSV uploaders (Active Directory integration, password automation, org assignments).
• Built internal admin tool for auditing and tenant management; developed DbContext interceptor to track CRUD across APIs.
• Integrated Active Directory tenant management and automated weekly usage emails via Azure Functions.
• Created FHIR-compatible REST APIs, documented with Swagger/OpenAPI and Postman.
• Led and mentored an offshore development team, guiding the full development lifecycle and ensuring high-quality, low-defect code delivery.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Representational State Transfer (REST) · Angular · ASP.NET · Microsoft Azure

positions.title: Junior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Full-stack development on CRM for social-service programs, delivering secure, multi-organization administrative tools.
• Migrated thousands of lines of legacy VBA Access code to modern C# .NET MVC, increasing maintainability and performance.
• Built custom admin features to improve security, reporting, and user management.
• Developed backend logic in SQL Server, including stored procedures and optimized queries.
• Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure features met client and compliance requirements.
positions.insights: Skills: ASP.NET MVC · Full-Stack Development · Kendo Ui
